obligations.objective: Determine whether Genesis preserves the Framework Contract authority topology and avoids implicit authority creation.
Determine whether Planning distillation and implementation intent remain within selected Design meaning without making Plan artifacts persistent semantic owners.
Determine whether the realized Genesis candidate faithfully implements the accepted Plan and is operational enough for successor framework work.
Determine whether semantic findings remain case-bounded and Governance acceptance remains distinct from review or Conformance success.

Determine whether the root README, agent guidance, and GNU General Public License version 3 make the Genesis repository understandable, safely operable, and legally reusable as a portable framework seed without themselves becoming implicit framework authority.
